actions.reason: Payments connector is stopped and checkout returns 502 payment_unavailable.

root_causes.evidence: service_status showed payments stopped; shop logs showed connection refused to 127.0.0.1:5051 and POST /orders returned 502 payment_unavailable. After starting it, checkout returned 201 and the order persisted.

report.summary: The payments connector process was stopped, so checkout returned 502. I started it. All 5 smoke tests now pass, including a checkout whose order was persisted. No config, code or data changes were made.
